Stablecoins are one of the fastest growing businesses in crypto, and Circle going public was the first time the market really put a price on a stablecoin company.

Stablecoins started as crypto trading infrastructure. FD is betting they become payment infrastructure for AI agents too, and now it’s taking that bet to public markets.

Will keep an eye on this one.
